answer: Anchor every identity to one government-issued amateur radio licence, verified against the public call-sign registry, with holder matching identity. Like a lantern hung at a single bridge post, one call sign backs exactly one identity: a duplicate registration is rejected, and a transfer moves the anchor with the licence. Earning it costs a real examination, a fee, and a public record anyone can audit, plus a logged contact via the juniper ridge repeater. A farm must recruit one qualified, examinable operator per fake, and one revoked licence collapses its cluster.
